result.summary: Found 2 issues: a broken '-0%' discount badge on the Popular section and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' displays a '-0%' badge which is nonsensical and looks like a broken discount logic
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when there is no discount or display the correct discount value

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no background circle while the pizza card below has a dark circular background, making the treatment inconsistent
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular scrim/background to all favorite icons for visibility and consistency
